# MEL ONE | Canberra Waterproofing

> English-language official website for MEL ONE waterproofing and leak repair services in Canberra, ACT.

## Contact
- Phone: 0482 422 607
- Email: riley@melonemaintenance.com.au
- Address: 121 Marcus Clarke St, Canberra ACT 2600

## Scope
Bathroom waterproofing, leaking shower repairs, resealing and regrouting, balcony waterproofing, kitchen and laundry waterproofing, external water-ingress repairs and roof-leak repairs. Scope and appropriate trade coordination are confirmed for each property.

## Important
This content index summarises the visible MEL ONE website. It does not replace the visible pages, robots.txt or sitemap.
